newsitem.title: USA: West TeleServices ok with 97 EPS of $0.58.
newsitem.headline: West TeleServices ok with 97 EPS of $0.58.

text.p: West TeleServices Corp said Tuesday the decline in its stock price resulted from the actions of one large institutional holder during the last hour of market trading Tuesday.
Calls to the company's offices in Nebraska Tuesday evening seeking further information were not immediately returned.

West TeleServices, one of the largest independent teleservices companies in the United States, said in a statement that it knew of no other reason for Tuesday's decline in its stock price on heavier trading volume than average.

"Our business fundamentals are unchanged since we reported our first quarter results on April 29," the company statement said. "The decline in the stock price resulted from the actions of one large institutional holder during the last hour of market trading today."

The company said it remains positive in its outlook for continued consistent growth and is "very comfortable" with estimated revenues for 1997 of about $387 million and an earnings per share of $0.58.
"We are continuing to pursue our strategies to grow by reinvesting in new teleservice facilities and new technology while maintaining high profitability," the company said.
